(*
theory RSF_Verification
imports
  Main
  "HOL-Library.IEEE_Floating_Point"
  "HOL-Library.Monad_Syntax"
  "HOL-Library.List_Product"
  "Refine_Imperative_HOL.Refine_Imperative_HOL"
begin

(* 1. Error and Result Monad *)
datatype err =
  InvalidDimension |
  InvalidLayerCount |
  TooLarge |
  NonFinite |
  InvalidConfig |
  ShapeMismatch |
  DataLengthMismatch |
  NotInitialized |
  NumericFailure |
  BadFileFormat |
  UnsupportedVersion |
  Overflow |
  OutOfMemory |
  IoError

datatype ('a,'e) result = Ok 'a | Err 'e

notation (output)
  bind_result (infixl "⟫" 50)

definition return_err :: "'e ⇒ ('a,'e) result" where
  "return_err e = Err e"

instantiation result :: (type, type) monad
begin
definition return_result :: "'a ⇒ ('a,'e) result" where
  "return_result a = Ok a"
definition bind_result_monad :: "('a,'e) result ⇒ ('a ⇒ ('b,'e) result) ⇒ ('b,'e) result" where
  "bind_result_monad = bind_result"
instance by (intro_classes) (auto simp add: return_result_def bind_result_monad_def)
end

(* 2. IEEE-754 f32 Exact Model *)
type_synonym f32 = "float"

definition is_finite_f32 :: "f32 ⇒ bool" where
  "is_finite_f32 x = is_finite x"

definition clamp_finite :: "f32 ⇒ f32" where
  "clamp_finite x = (if is_finite_f32 x then x else 0.0)"

definition clip_f32 :: "f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32" where
  "clip_f32 min max x = (if float_less x min then min else if float_less max x then max else x)"

definition f32_add :: "f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32" where
  "f32_add = float_add"

definition f32_mul :: "f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32" where
  "f32_mul = float_mul"

definition f32_div :: "f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32" where
  "f32_div = float_div"

definition f32_exp :: "f32 ⇒ f32" where
  "f32_exp = float_exp"

definition f32_sqrt :: "f32 ⇒ f32" where
  "f32_sqrt = float_sqrt"

definition f32_of_nat :: "nat ⇒ f32" where
  "f32_of_nat n = (float_of_int (int n))"

definition nat_of_f32 :: "f32 ⇒ nat option" where
  "nat_of_f32 x = (if is_finite_f32 x ∧ 0 ≤ x ∧ x < float_of_int (max_signed_value TYPE(nat)) then Some (nat (int_of_float x)) else None)"

(* 3. Tensor Model *)
record tensor =
  shape :: "nat list"
  data  :: "f32 list"

definition tensor_invariant :: "tensor ⇒ bool" where
  "tensor_invariant t = (length (shape t) = 2 ∧ length (data t) = (shape t)!0 * (shape t)!1)"

definition is_2d_tensor :: "tensor ⇒ bool" where
  "is_2d_tensor t = tensor_invariant t"

definition batch_size :: "tensor ⇒ nat" where
  "batch_size t = (if tensor_invariant t then (shape t)!0 else 0)"

definition tensor_dim :: "tensor ⇒ nat" where
  "tensor_dim t = (if tensor_invariant t then (shape t)!1 else 0)"

lemma tensor_invariantD:
  assumes "tensor_invariant t"
  shows "length (shape t) = 2" and "length (data t) = (shape t)!0 * (shape t)!1"
  using assms by (auto simp add: tensor_invariant_def)

lemma batch_sizeD:
  assumes "tensor_invariant t"
  shows "batch_size t = (shape t)!0"
  using assms by (auto simp add: batch_size_def tensor_invariant_def)

lemma tensor_dimD:
  assumes "tensor_invariant t"
  shows "tensor_dim t = (shape t)!1"
  using assms by (auto simp add: tensor_dim_def tensor_invariant_def)

lemma tensor_index_bound:
  assumes "tensor_invariant t" and "i < length (data t)"
  shows "i div (shape t)!1 < (shape t)!0" and "i mod (shape t)!1 < (shape t)!1"
  using assms by (auto simp add: tensor_invariant_def div_mult_mod_eq)

definition assert_2d_and_len :: "tensor ⇒ (unit, err) result" where
  "assert_2d_and_len t = (
    if length (shape t) ≠ 2 then return_err ShapeMismatch else
    let rows = (shape t)!0; cols = (shape t)!1;
        expected = rows * cols
    in if length (data t) ≠ expected then return_err DataLengthMismatch else return ()
  )"

lemma assert_2d_and_len_correct:
  assumes "tensor_invariant t"
  shows "assert_2d_and_len t = Ok ()"
  using assms by (auto simp add: assert_2d_and_len_def tensor_invariant_def)

lemma assert_2d_and_len_fails:
  assumes "¬tensor_invariant t"
  shows "assert_2d_and_len t ≠ Ok ()"
  using assms by (auto simp add: assert_2d_and_len_def tensor_invariant_def split: if_split_asm)

(* 4. Pure Tensor Operations *)
definition transpose_pure :: "tensor ⇒ tensor" where
  "transpose_pure t = (
    let rows = (shape t)!0; cols = (shape t)!1;
        new_data = [ data t ! (r*cols + c) | c ← [0..<cols], r ← [0..<rows] ]
    in ⦇ shape = [cols, rows], data = new_data ⦈
  )"

lemma transpose_pure_invariant:
  assumes "tensor_invariant t"
  shows "tensor_invariant (transpose_pure t)"
  using assms by (auto simp add: tensor_invariant_def transpose_pure_def)

definition matmul_entry :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ nat ⇒ nat ⇒ f32" where
  "matmul_entry A B r c = (
    let cols_A = (shape A)!1;
        cols_B = (shape B)!1;
        terms = [ f32_mul (data A ! (r*cols_A + k)) (data B ! (k*cols_B + c)) | k ← [0..<cols_A] ]
    in sum_list terms
  )"

definition matmul_pure :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (tensor, err) result" where
  "matmul_pure A B = (
    if ¬tensor_invariant A ∨ ¬tensor_invariant B then return_err ShapeMismatch else
    let rows_A = (shape A)!0; cols_A = (shape A)!1;
        rows_B = (shape B)!0; cols_B = (shape B)!1
    in if cols_A ≠ rows_B then return_err ShapeMismatch else
    let new_shape = [rows_A, cols_B];
        new_data = map (matmul_entry A B) (cartesian_product [0..<rows_A] [0..<cols_B])
    in if length new_data = rows_A * cols_B then Ok ⦇ shape = new_shape, data = new_data ⦈ else return_err DataLengthMismatch
  )"

lemma matmul_pure_invariant:
  assumes "tensor_invariant A" and "tensor_invariant B" and "cols_A = rows_B"
  shows "tensor_invariant (the (matmul_pure A B))"
  using assms by (auto simp add: matmul_pure_def tensor_invariant_def split: if_split_asm)

definition add_pure :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (tensor, err) result" where
  "add_pure t1 t2 = (
    if shape t1 ≠ shape t2 then return_err ShapeMismatch else
    if length (data t1) ≠ length (data t2) then return_err DataLengthMismatch else
    Ok ⦇ shape = shape t1, data = zip_with f32_add (data t1) (data t2) ⦈
  )"

definition sub_pure :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (tensor, err) result" where
  "sub_pure t1 t2 = (
    if shape t1 ≠ shape t2 then return_err ShapeMismatch else
    if length (data t1) ≠ length (data t2) then return_err DataLengthMismatch else
    Ok ⦇ shape = shape t1, data = zip_with f32_sub (data t1) (data t2) ⦈
  )"

definition div_pure :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (tensor, err) result" where
  "div_pure t1 t2 = (
    if shape t1 ≠ shape t2 then return_err ShapeMismatch else
    if length (data t1) ≠ length (data t2) then return_err DataLengthMismatch else
    Ok ⦇ shape = shape t1, data = zip_with f32_div (data t1) (data t2) ⦈
  )"

definition clip_pure :: "f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor" where
  "clip_pure min max t = ⦇ shape = shape t, data = map (clip_f32 min max) (data t) ⦈"

definition exp_pure :: "tensor ⇒ (tensor, err) result" where
  "exp_pure t = (
    if ∀v∈set (data t). is_finite_f32 v then
      Ok ⦇ shape = shape t, data = map f32_exp (data t) ⦈
    else return_err NumericFailure
  )"

definition zeros_pure :: "nat list ⇒ (tensor, err) result" where
  "zeros_pure shape = (
    if length shape ≠ 2 then return_err ShapeMismatch else
    let rows = shape!0; cols = shape!1;
        data = replicate (rows*cols) 0.0
    in Ok ⦇ shape = shape, data = data ⦈
  )"

definition copy_pure :: "tensor ⇒ tensor" where
  "copy_pure t = ⦇ shape = shape t, data = data t ⦈"

(* Random uniform: we model as uninterpreted due to complexity, but must handle overflow in seed *)
definition randomUniform_pure :: "nat list ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ u64 ⇒ (tensor × u64, err) result"

(* 5. RSFLayer Pure Specification *)
record rsf_layer_config =
  clip_min :: f32
  clip_max :: f32
  seed_offset :: u64
  grad_mean :: bool

record rsf_layer_state =
  s_weight :: tensor
  t_weight :: tensor
  s_bias :: tensor
  t_bias :: tensor
  s_weight_grad :: tensor
  t_weight_grad :: tensor
  s_bias_grad :: tensor
  t_bias_grad :: tensor
  dim :: nat
  clip_min :: f32
  clip_max :: f32
  grad_mean :: bool

definition rsf_layer_invariant :: "rsf_layer_state ⇒ bool" where
  "rsf_layer_invariant s = (
    tensor_invariant (s_weight s) ∧ shape (s_weight s) = [dim s, dim s] ∧
    tensor_invariant (t_weight s) ∧ shape (t_weight s) = [dim s, dim s] ∧
    tensor_invariant (s_bias s) ∧ shape (s_bias s) = [1, dim s] ∧
    tensor_invariant (t_bias s) ∧ shape (t_bias s) = [1, dim s] ∧
    tensor_invariant (s_weight_grad s) ∧ shape (s_weight_grad s) = [dim s, dim s] ∧
    tensor_invariant (t_weight_grad s) ∧ shape (t_weight_grad s) = [dim s, dim s] ∧
    tensor_invariant (s_bias_grad s) ∧ shape (s_bias_grad s) = [1, dim s] ∧
    tensor_invariant (t_bias_grad s) ∧ shape (t_bias_grad s) = [1, dim s] ∧
    dim s > 0 ∧
    is_finite_f32 (clip_min s) ∧ is_finite_f32 (clip_max s) ∧
    clip_min s < clip_max s
  )"

definition add_bias_pure :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor" where
  "add_bias_pure t bias = (
    let batch = batch_size t;
        dim = tensor_dim t;
        bias_data = data bias;
        new_data = [ data t ! (b*dim + d) + bias_data ! d | b ← [0..<batch], d ← [0..<dim] ]
    in ⦇ shape = shape t, data = new_data ⦈
  )"

definition rsf_layer_assert_pair :: "rsf_layer_state ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (nat, err) result" where
  "rsf_layer_assert_pair self a b = (
    assert_2d_and_len a ⟫ (λ_.
    assert_2d_and_len b ⟫ (λ_.
    if shape a ≠ shape b then return_err ShapeMismatch else
    if tensor_dim a ≠ dim self ∨ tensor_dim b ≠ dim self then return_err ShapeMismatch else
    if length (data (s_bias self)) ≠ dim self ∨ length (data (t_bias self)) ≠ dim self then return_err ShapeMismatch else
    if ¬is_finite_f32 (clip_min self) ∨ ¬is_finite_f32 (clip_max self) then return_err NonFinite else
    if ¬(clip_min self < clip_max self) then return_err InvalidConfig else
    return (batch_size a)
    )
  )"

lemma rsf_layer_assert_pair_correct:
  assumes "rsf_layer_invariant self" and "tensor_invariant a" and "tensor_invariant b"
    and "shape a = shape b" and "tensor_dim a = dim self" and "tensor_dim b = dim self"
    and "length (data (s_bias self)) = dim self" and "length (data (t_bias self)) = dim self"
    and "is_finite_f32 (clip_min self)" and "is_finite_f32 (clip_max self)" and "clip_min self < clip_max self"
  shows "rsf_layer_assert_pair self a b = Ok (batch_size a)"
  using assms by (auto simp add: rsf_layer_assert_pair_def assert_2d_and_len_correct tensor_invariantD)

definition rsf_layer_forward_pure :: "rsf_layer_state ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (unit, err) result" where
  "rsf_layer_forward_pure self x1 x2 = (
    rsf_layer_assert_pair self x1 x2 ⟫ (λbatch.
    let x2_t = transpose_pure x2;
        s_x2_t = (case matmul_pure (s_weight self) x2_t of Ok m ⇒ m | Err e ⇒ return e);
        s_x2 = transpose_pure s_x2_t;
        s_x2_with_bias = add_bias_pure s_x2 (s_bias self);
        s_x2_clipped = clip_pure (clip_min self) (clip_max self) s_x2_with_bias;
        s_x2_exp = (case exp_pure s_x2_clipped of Ok e ⇒ e | Err e ⇒ return e);
        x1_new = ⦇ shape = shape x1, data = zip_with f32_mul (data x1) (data s_x2_exp) ⦈;
        x1_t = transpose_pure x1_new;
        t_x1_t = (case matmul_pure (t_weight self) x1_t of Ok m ⇒ m | Err e ⇒ return e);
        t_x1 = transpose_pure t_x1_t;
        t_x1_with_bias = add_bias_pure t_x1 (t_bias self);
        x2_new = (case add_pure x2 t_x1_with_bias of Ok m ⇒ m | Err e ⇒ return e)
    in return ()
  )"

definition rsf_layer_inverse_pure :: "rsf_layer_state ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (unit, err) result" where
  "rsf_layer_inverse_pure self y1 y2 = (
    rsf_layer_assert_pair self y1 y2 ⟫ (λbatch.
    let y1_t = transpose_pure y1;
        t_y1_t = (case matmul_pure (t_weight self) y1_t of Ok m ⇒ m | Err e ⇒ return e);
        t_y1 = transpose_pure t_y1_t;
        t_y1_with_bias = add_bias_pure t_y1 (t_bias self);
        y2_new = (case sub_pure y2 t_y1_with_bias of Ok m ⇒ m | Err e ⇒ return e);
        y2_t = transpose_pure y2_new;
        s_y2_t = (case matmul_pure (s_weight self) y2_t of Ok m ⇒ m | Err e ⇒ return e);
        s_y2 = transpose_pure s_y2_t;
        s_y2_with_bias = add_bias_pure s_y2 (s_bias self);
        s_y2_clipped = clip_pure (clip_min self) (clip_max self) s_y2_with_bias;
        s_y2_exp = (case exp_pure s_y2_clipped of Ok e ⇒ e | Err e ⇒ return e)
    in if (∀v∈set (data s_y2_exp). v ≠ 0 ∧ is_finite_f32 v) then return () else return_err NumericFailure
  )"

definition rsf_layer_backward_pure :: "rsf_layer_state ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (unit, err) result" where
  "rsf_layer_backward_pure self y1 y2 dy1_in dy2_in x1_out x2_out dx1_out dx2_out = (
    rsf_layer_assert_pair self y1 y2 ⟫ (λ_.
    rsf_layer_assert_pair self dy1_in dy2_in ⟫ (λ_.
    if shape x1_out ≠ [batch_size y1, dim self] ∨ shape x2_out ≠ [batch_size y1, dim self] ∨
       shape dx1_out ≠ [batch_size y1, dim self] ∨ shape dx2_out ≠ [batch_size y1, dim self] then return_err ShapeMismatch else
    if length (data x1_out) ≠ batch_size y1 * dim self ∨ length (data x2_out) ≠ batch_size y1 * dim self ∨
       length (data dx1_out) ≠ batch_size y1 * dim self ∨ length (data dx2_out) ≠ batch_size y1 * dim self then return_err DataLengthMismatch else
    let batch = batch_size y1;
        dy1 = copy_pure dy1_in;
        dy2 = copy_pure dy2_in;
        y1_t = transpose_pure y1;
        t_y1_t = (case matmul_pure (t_weight self) y1_t of Ok m ⇒ m | Err e ⇒ return e);
        t_y1 = transpose_pure t_y1_t;
        t_y1_with_bias = add_bias_pure t_y1 (t_bias self);
        x2 = (case sub_pure y2 t_y1_with_bias of Ok m ⇒ m | Err e ⇒ return e);
        dy2_t = transpose_pure dy2;
        dt = (case matmul_pure dy2_t y1 of Ok m ⇒ m | Err e ⇒ return e);
        grad_scale = (if grad_mean self then f32_div (f32_of_nat 1) (f32_of_nat batch) else 1.0);
        _ = ⦇ s_weight_grad = ⦇ data = zip_with f32_add (data (s_weight_grad self)) (map (λv. f32_mul v grad_scale) (data dt)) ⦈ ⦈;
        _ = ⦇ t_bias_grad = ⦇ data = zip_with f32_add (data (t_bias_grad self)) (map (λv. f32_mul v grad_scale) (take (dim self) (cycle (data dy2)))) ⦈ ⦈;
        t_weight_t = transpose_pure (t_weight self);
        grad_from_t_t = (case matmul_pure t_weight_t dy2_t of Ok m ⇒ m | Err e ⇒ return e);
        grad_from_t = transpose_pure grad_from_t_t;
        dy1' = (case add_pure dy1 grad_from_t of Ok m ⇒ m | Err e ⇒ return e);
        x2_t = transpose_pure x2;
        s_pre_t = (case matmul_pure (s_weight self) x2_t of Ok m ⇒ m | Err e ⇒ return e);
        s_pre = transpose_pure s_pre_t;
        s_pre_with_bias = add_bias_pure s_pre (s_bias self);
        s_clipped = clip_pure (clip_min self) (clip_max self) s_pre_with_bias;
        exp_s = (case exp_pure s_clipped of Ok e ⇒ e | Err e ⇒ return e);
        x1 = (case div_pure y1 exp_s of Ok m ⇒ m | Err e ⇒ return e);
        _ = ⦇ x1_out = x1 ⦈;
        _ = ⦇ x2_out = x2 ⦈;
        dx1 = ⦇ shape = shape x1, data = zip_with f32_mul (data dy1') (data exp_s) ⦈;
        dscale = ⦇ shape = shape x1, data = zip_with f32_mul (data dy1') (data x1) ⦈;
        ds = ⦇ shape = shape x1, data = zip_with f32_mul (data dscale) (data exp_s) ⦈;
        ds' = ⦇ shape = shape ds, data = [ if (¬is_finite_f32 (s_pre.data ! (b*dim self + d)) ∨
                                          s_pre.data ! (b*dim self + d) < clip_min self ∨
                                          s_pre.data ! (b*dim self + d) > clip_max self)
                                        then 0.0 else v
                                      | b ← [0..<batch], d ← [0..<dim self],
                                        let idx = b*dim self + d; v ← [ds.data ! idx] ] ⦈;
        ds_t = transpose_pure ds';
        ds_w = (case matmul_pure ds_t x2 of Ok m ⇒ m | Err e ⇒ return e);
        _ = ⦇ s_weight_grad = ⦇ data = zip_with f32_add (data (s_weight_grad self)) (map (λv. f32_mul v grad_scale) (data ds_w)) ⦈ ⦈;
        _ = ⦇ s_bias_grad = ⦇ data = zip_with f32_add (data (s_bias_grad self)) (map (λv. f32_mul v grad_scale) (take (dim self) (cycle (data ds')))) ⦈ ⦈;
        s_weight_t = transpose_pure (s_weight self);
        grad_from_s_t = (case matmul_pure s_weight_t ds_t of Ok m ⇒ m | Err e ⇒ return e);
        grad_from_s = transpose_pure grad_from_s_t;
        dx2 = ⦇ shape = shape dy2, data = zip_with f32_add (data dy2) (data grad_from_s) ⦈;
        _ = ⦇ dx1_out = dx1 ⦈;
        _ = ⦇ dx2_out = dx2 ⦈
    in return ()
  )"

(* 6. RSF Pure Specification *)
record rsf_config =
  clip_min :: f32
  clip_max :: f32
  grad_mean :: bool
  max_dim :: nat
  max_layers :: nat

record control_block =
  freed :: bool
  dim :: nat
  num_layers :: nat
  layers :: "rsf_layer_state list"
  cfg :: rsf_config

type_synonym rsf = control_block

definition rsf_invariant :: "rsf ⇒ bool" where
  "rsf_invariant r = (
    ¬freed r ∧
    dim r > 0 ∧ num_layers r > 0 ∧
    dim r ≤ max_dim (cfg r) ∧ num_layers r ≤ max_layers (cfg r) ∧
    is_finite_f32 (clip_min (cfg r)) ∧ is_finite_f32 (clip_max (cfg r)) ∧
    clip_min (cfg r) < clip_max (cfg r) ∧
    length (layers r) = num_layers r ∧
    all rsf_layer_invariant (layers r) ∧
    all (λl. dim l = dim r) (layers r)
  )"

definition split_tensor :: "tensor ⇒ nat ⇒ tensor × tensor" where
  "split_tensor x dim = (
    let batch = batch_size x;
        x1_data = [ data x ! (b*2*dim + d) | b ← [0..<batch], d ← [0..<dim] ];
        x2_data = [ data x ! (b*2*dim + dim + d) | b ← [0..<batch], d ← [0..<dim] ]
    in (⦇ shape = [batch, dim], data = x1_data ⦈, ⦇ shape = [batch, dim], data = x2_data ⦈)
  )"

definition merge_tensor :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ nat ⇒ tensor" where
  "merge_tensor x1 x2 dim = (
    let batch = batch_size x1;
        merged_data = concat [ [x1.data ! (b*dim + d), x2.data ! (b*dim + d)] | b ← [0..<batch], d ← [0..<dim] ]
    in ⦇ shape = [batch, 2*dim], data = merged_data ⦈
  )"

definition rsf_forward_pure :: "rsf ⇒ tensor ⇒ (tensor, err) result" where
  "rsf_forward_pure r x = (
    if freed r then return_err NotInitialized else
    if ¬tensor_invariant x then return_err ShapeMismatch else
    if tensor_dim x ≠ dim r * 2 then return_err ShapeMismatch else
    let (x1, x2) = split_tensor x (dim r);
        (final_x1, final_x2) = foldl (λ(x1,x2) l. (case rsf_layer_forward_pure l x1 x2 of Ok _ ⇒ (x1,x2) | Err e ⇒ return e)) (x1,x2) (layers r)
    in case final_x1 of
         _ ⇒ Ok (merge_tensor x1 x2 (dim r))
  )"

definition rsf_inverse_pure :: "rsf ⇒ tensor ⇒ (tensor, err) result" where
  "rsf_inverse_pure r y = (
    if freed r then return_err NotInitialized else
    if ¬tensor_invariant y then return_err ShapeMismatch else
    if tensor_dim y ≠ dim r * 2 then return_err ShapeMismatch else
    let (y1, y2) = split_tensor y (dim r);
        (final_y1, final_y2) = foldl (λ(y1,y2) l. (case rsf_layer_inverse_pure l y1 y2 of Ok _ ⇒ (y1,y2) | Err e ⇒ return e)) (y1,y2) (rev (layers r))
    in case final_y1 of
         _ ⇒ Ok (merge_tensor y1 y2 (dim r))
  )"

definition rsf_backward_pure :: "rsf ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (tensor, err) result" where
  "rsf_backward_pure r grad_output input grad_input_out = (
    if freed r then return_err NotInitialized else
    if ¬tensor_invariant grad_output ∨ ¬tensor_invariant input ∨ ¬tensor_invariant grad_input_out then return_err ShapeMismatch else
    if tensor_dim grad_output ≠ dim r * 2 ∨ tensor_dim input ≠ dim r * 2 ∨ tensor_dim grad_input_out ≠ dim r * 2 then return_err ShapeMismatch else
    let batch = batch_size input;
        shape_half = [batch, dim r];
        x = (case rsf_forward_pure r input of Ok x' ⇒ x' | Err e ⇒ return e);
        (y1, y2) = split_tensor x (dim r);
        (dy1, dy2) = split_tensor grad_output (dim r);
        (cur_y1, cur_y2, cur_dy1, cur_dy2) = (y1, y2, dy1, dy2);

definition rsf_impl_rel :: "rsf ⇒ rsf ⇒ bool" where
  "rsf_impl_rel impl pure = (

    num_layers impl = num_layers pure ∧

(* 6. RSF Pure Specification *)
record rsf_config =
  clip_min :: f32
  clip_max :: f32
  grad_mean :: bool
  max_dim :: nat
  max_layers :: nat

record control_block =
  freed :: bool
  dim :: nat
  num_layers :: nat
  layers :: "rsf_layer_state list"
  cfg :: rsf_config

type_synonym rsf = control_block

definition rsf_invariant :: "rsf ⇒ bool" where
  "rsf_invariant r = (
    ¬freed r ∧
    dim r > 0 ∧ num_layers r > 0 ∧
    dim r ≤ max_dim (cfg r) ∧ num_layers r ≤ max_layers (cfg r) ∧
    is_finite_f32 (clip_min (cfg r)) ∧ is_finite_f32 (clip_max (cfg r)) ∧
    clip_min (cfg r) < clip_max (cfg r) ∧
    length (layers r) = num_layers r ∧
    all rsf_layer_invariant (layers r) ∧
    all (λl. dim l = dim r) (layers r)

definition split_tensor :: "tensor ⇒ nat ⇒ tensor × tensor" where
  "split_tensor x dim = (
    let batch = batch_size x;
        x1_data = [ data x ! (b*2*dim + d) | b ← [0..<batch], d ← [0..<dim] ];
        x2_data = [ data x ! (b*2*dim + dim + d) | b ← [0..<batch], d ← [0..<dim] ]
    in (⦇ shape = [batch, dim], data = x1_data ⦈, ⦇ shape = [batch, dim], data = x2_data ⦈)
  )"

definition merge_tensor :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ nat ⇒ tensor" where
  "merge_tensor x1 x2 dim = (
    let batch = batch_size x1;
        merged_data = concat [ [x1.data ! (b*dim + d), x2.data ! (b*dim + d)] | b ← [0..<batch], d ← [0..<dim] ]
    in ⦇ shape = [batch, 2*dim], data = merged_data ⦈
  )"

definition rsf_forward_pure :: "rsf ⇒ tensor ⇒ (tensor, err) result" where
  "rsf_forward_pure r x = (
    if freed r then return_err NotInitialized else
    if ¬tensor_invariant x then return_err ShapeMismatch else
    if tensor_dim x ≠ dim r * 2 then return_err ShapeMismatch else
    let (x1, x2) = split_tensor x (dim r);
        (final_x1, final_x2) = foldl (λ(x1,x2) l. (case rsf_layer_forward_pure l x1 x2 of Ok _ ⇒ (x1,x2) | Err e ⇒ return e)) (x1,x2) (layers r)
    in case final_x1 of
         _ ⇒ Ok (merge_tensor x1 x2 (dim r))
  )"

definition rsf_inverse_pure :: "rsf ⇒ tensor ⇒ (tensor, err) result" where
  "rsf_inverse_pure r y = (
    if freed r then return_err NotInitialized else
    if ¬tensor_invariant y then return_err ShapeMismatch else
    if tensor_dim y ≠ dim r * 2 then return_err ShapeMismatch else
    let (y1, y2) = split_tensor y (dim r);
        (final_y1, final_y2) = foldl (λ(y1,y2) l. (case rsf_layer_inverse_pure l y1 y2 of Ok _ ⇒ (y1,y2) | Err e ⇒ return e)) (y1,y2) (rev (layers r))
    in case final_y1 of
         _ ⇒ Ok (merge_tensor y1 y2 (dim r))
  )"

definition rsf_backward_pure :: "rsf ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (tensor, err) result" where
  "rsf_backward_pure r grad_output input grad_input_out = (
    if freed r then return_err NotInitialized else
    if ¬tensor_invariant grad_output ∨ ¬tensor_invariant input ∨ ¬tensor_invariant grad_input_out then return_err ShapeMismatch else
    if tensor_dim grad_output ≠ dim r * 2 ∨ tensor_dim input ≠ dim r * 2 ∨ tensor_dim grad_input_out ≠ dim r * 2 then return_err ShapeMismatch else
    let batch = batch_size input;
        shape_half = [batch, dim r];
        x = (case rsf_forward_pure r input of Ok x' ⇒ x' | Err e ⇒ return e);
        (y1, y2) = split_tensor x (dim r);
        (dy1, dy2) = split_tensor grad_output (dim r);
        (cur_y1, cur_y2, cur_dy1, cur_dy2) = (y1, y2, dy1, dy2);
        (x1_prev, x2_prev, dx1_prev, dx2_prev) = (zeros_pure shape_half ⟫ (λx1. (x1, zeros_pure shape_half ⟫ (λx2. (x1, x2, zeros_pure shape_half, zeros_pure shape_half)))));
        (dx1_final, dx2_final) = (dx1_prev, dx2_prev)
    in (
      foldl (λ(dx1_prev, dx2_prev) i.
        let layer = layers r ! i;
            (x1_prev', x2_prev', dx1_prev', dx2_prev') = (case rsf_layer_backward_pure layer cur_y1 cur_y2 cur_dy1 cur_dy2 x1_prev x2_prev dx1_prev dx2_prev of
              Ok _ ⇒ (x1_prev, x2_prev, dx1_prev, dx2_prev) | Err e ⇒ return e)

definition assert_2d_and_len_impl :: "tensor_impl ⇒ heap ⇒ (unit, err) result" where
  "assert_2d_and_len_impl t h = (
    case h t of None ⇒ return_err ShapeMismatch | Some tensor ⇒

definition clampFiniteInPlace_impl :: "tensor_impl ⇒ heap ⇒ heap" where
  "clampFiniteInPlace_impl t h = (

    let h' = h;

        h'''''''' = clampFiniteInPlace_impl (the t_x1_impl) (the h'''''''');
        h_final' = (case add_impl x2 (the t_x1_impl) (the h'''''''') of Ok (_, h) ⇒ Some h | Err e ⇒ None);
        h_final'' = clampFiniteInPlace_impl x2 (the h_final')
    in case (x2_t_impl, s_x2_t_impl, s_x2_impl, x1_t_impl, t_x1_t_impl, t_x1_impl, h_final', h_final'') of
